patterns.title: Scroll Product Story
patterns.description: A pinned product narrative with one continuous hero object, scene wipe, editorial type layering and interactive feature hotspots.

primitives.name: ScrollProduct
primitives.description: Moves one focal product through several narrative compositions while preserving object continuity.

primitives.name: SceneWipe
primitives.description: Transitions between dark hero and light editorial surface using one scroll-scrubbed sheet.

primitives.name: ProductMaskText
primitives.description: Splits typography into foreground/background layers so the product can pass through type intentionally.

primitives.name: FeatureHotspot
primitives.description: Turns floating feature pills into compact detail disclosures without replacing the composition.

responsive.desktop: Wide editorial composition with product traveling through type layers.
responsive.tablet: Reduced scale and tighter motion envelope while preserving scene sequence.
responsive.mobile: Simplified vertical composition; product remains dominant and feature disclosure stays tap-safe.

acceptance: Product remains one continuous object across scenes.
Typography/product overlap must look intentional rather than accidental.
Feature hotspots are optional to core comprehension and work with touch.
